caption: The drawing depicts a single glass positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The glass is rendered in shades of gray with detailed texturing on its surface, particularly around the bowl and stem, indicating a faceted pattern. The bowl of the glass is widemouthed, narrowing towards the base and then flaring out again at the foot. A thin horizontal line passes behind the glass, roughly at the midpoint of its height. Below and to the right of the glass, the name “Michael Trekur” is written in stylized handwriting. There are no other objects or elements in the composition.
title: Liqueur Glass
